metadata.transformations: O*NET-SOC 2019 occupations are linked to ANZSCO v1.3 occupations through ISCO-08 unit groups (the ESCO crosswalk code prefix and the ABS correspondence), and only where an O*NET title exactly equals an official ANZSCO name. Titles are de-parenthesised and limited in length; titles that are already official ANZSCO names, generic, numeric or claimed by several occupations are excluded. ESCO labels are not included. Synonyms are retrieval keywords, not official ANZSCO titles.
